Hi Tom. Are you still planning to join us when Owe
interview Pim Juntasa on Wednesday? She seems like a
really promising candidate.
Yes, you can count on me. I'll be there at two P.M. The
usual place, right? Meeting Room A?
No. Actually, @someone’s already booked Meeting Room
A. So, instead, we'll be in the small meeting room on the
first floor.
Good to know, thanks. Oh, and I’ve revised the interview
questions. Til pass out photocopies of them to everyone
before Wednesday.

了解了，谢谢。哦，我还修改了面试问题。周三前把复印件发给每个人。
